methodological_policy: HHH calendar date must equal either VI/25 initial observing-night date or the authoritative normalized UTC exposure-start date; no arbitrary +/-1-day tolerance.
reason: Four SkyView fallback jobs were terminal solely because the old HHH DATE-OBS gate required equality with VI/25 initial observing-night date. Reviewed pixel-equivalent controls and VI/25 timestamp normalization establish two supported historical encodings: initial observing-night date or normalized UTC exposure date.
